1.cue: Bar sits high on your traps. Brace your core before you go down. Knees track over your toes. Go down to at least parallel.
1.err: Knees caving in, heels lifting, half reps

2.cue: Bar sits on your rear shoulders. Lean your torso forward more. Keep your wrists straight.
2.err: Elbow and wrist pain, hips rising first

3.cue: Elbows high, torso upright, full depth
3.err: Elbows dropping and the bar rolling forward

4.cue: Hold the weight at your chest. Sit down between your heels.

5.cue: Pause 2–3 s at the bottom without relaxing

6.cue: Sit back onto the box while staying tight

7.cue: Heels on 2–5 cm, narrow stance, knees forward

8.cue: Feet slightly in front of the bar

9.cue: Back against the pad, full depth

10.cue: Go down until just before your pelvis tucks under. Push through mid-foot.
10.err: Pelvis lifting off the pad, slamming knees into lockout

11.cue: Upright torso, no load on your back

12.cue: Bar over mid-foot, shins touch the bar, "pull the slack out," back tight, push the floor away
12.err: Lower back rounding, hips rising first, bar drifting away

13.cue: Wide stance, knees out, upright torso
13.err: Hips too high, knees caving in

14.cue: Soft knees, push your hips back, bar slides down your thighs, stop when your hips stop
14.err: Turning it into a squat, rounding your back to reach the floor

16.cue: Knees almost straight, from the floor every rep

17.cue: Neutral handles, more knee bend, chest up

18.cue: Bar below or above the knee, same lockout mechanics
18.err: Hitching the bar up your thighs

20.cue: Bar on your back, soft knees, bend to parallel or as far as your mobility allows

21.cue: Upper back on the bench edge, shins vertical at the top, chin tucked
21.err: Arching your lower back instead of extending your hips

23.cue: Hinge, don't squat. Snap your hips. The bell floats to chest height.

24.cue: Back to the machine, hinge, squeeze your glutes

25.cue: Raise your legs to hip level with control

26.cue: Back foot on the bench, front foot far enough out. Leaning forward = glutes, staying upright = quads.

27.cue: Back knee drops straight down to the floor

28.cue: Long step for glutes, touch your knee down with control

30.cue: Whole foot on the box, push through your top leg
30.err: Pushing off with your bottom leg

31.cue: Hips level, free leg reaches back

32.cue: Sit into one hip, keep the other leg straight

33.cue: Controlled descent, arms out for balance

34.cue: Shoulder blades squeezed and down, feet planted, bar touches your lower chest, forearms vertical
34.err: Elbows flared to 90°, bouncing off your chest, butt lifting, wrists bent back

35.cue: Pause 1–2 s, motionless on your chest

37.cue: About 30° is best for upper chest
37.err: Angle too steep (it becomes a shoulder exercise)

40.cue: Lock your feet in, bar to your lower chest

41.cue: Elbows touch the floor and stop

42.cue: Bar stops 5–10 cm above your chest

43.cue: Pause 2–3 cm above your chest without touching

44.cue: Body stiff like a plank, elbows at 45°, chest to the floor
44.err: Hips sagging, elbows flared, half reps

45.cue: Lean forward, go down until your shoulders are slightly below your elbows
45.err: Going deep with pain, shrugging your shoulders

47.cue: Bench at 30°, bar to your upper chest

48.cue: Slight bend in the elbows, wide arc, deep stretch
48.err: Turning it into a press, overstretching

49.err: Bending your elbows so it turns into a press

51.cue: Squeeze your glutes, bar starts at your collarbone, push your head through at the top
51.err: Leaning back too much, bar path going around your face

52.cue: Back supported at 80–90°, dumbbells at ear level

53.cue: Rotate your grip as you press up

54.cue: Short dip, drive with your legs

55.cue: Half-kneeling or standing, press up and forward

57.cue: Sit on the floor with your legs straight

58.cue: Hips high, head in front of your hands

59.cue: Bend over 30–45°, pull to your lower ribs
59.err: Raising your torso every rep, jerking

60.cue: Torso parallel to the floor, bar stops on the floor each rep

61.cue: Pull your elbow toward your hip, full stretch at the bottom

62.err: Lifting your chest off the bench

63.cue: Lie face down on a high bench

64.cue: Reach forward to stretch, pull to your stomach

65.cue: Chest up, pull to your chest

67.cue: Body straight, chest to the bar

69.cue: Start from a dead hang, elbows to your ribs, chin over the bar, controlled descent

73.cue: Jump up and lower yourself over 3–5 s

74.cue: Lock your thighs in, lean back slightly, pull to your upper chest, full stretch at the top
74.err: Leaning back a lot, pulling behind your neck

76.cue: Big stretch overhead, elbow to your hip

77.cue: Arms almost straight, bar to your thighs

78.cue: Arms slightly bent, lower behind your head

82.cue: Arm locked out next to your ear

83.cue: Squeeze your glutes, tuck your pelvis

84.cue: Ribs down, roll out as far as your back stays straight

85.cue: Lower back pressed into the floor

87.cue: Curl your pelvis up, no swinging

89.cue: Press out and hold, resist the rotation

91.cue: Rotate from your hips and chest

93.cue: Elbows still, full extension at the bottom

94.cue: Arms behind your body, full stretch

95.cue: Back to the machine, arm behind your body

96.cue: Full extension at the bottom, the most important part

98.cue: Chest on the bench, arms vertical

101.cue: Back to the machine, elbows next to your head, deep stretch

102.cue: Seated with back support, elbows forward
102.err: Arching your back, elbow pain with heavy weight

103.cue: Lower behind your head, not to your forehead

104.err: Leaning over and using your bodyweight

105.cue: A mix of close-grip bench and skull crusher, bar to your chin line
105.err: Straining your elbows by going heavy too fast

107.cue: Upper arm parallel to the floor, lock out

108.cue: Lean forward slightly, lead with your elbows, up to shoulder height, controlled descent

109.cue: Start with your hand in front of your body for a stretch

110.cue: Hold a post and lean away

111.cue: Line up the machine's pivot with your shoulder

112.cue: Grip wider than your shoulders, elbows to shoulder height
112.err: Narrow grip and pulling too high

113.cue: Move your arms at shoulder level

115.cue: Pull to your eyes, elbows high, rotate out

116.cue: Cross the two cables, pull out and back

117.cue: Arms straight, pull to your chest

118.cue: Up toward your ears, short hold

119.cue: Thumbs up, arms in a Y shape

120.cue: Line up the machine's pivot with your knee, start from a deep bend

122.cue: Kneel and lean back with straight hips

125.cue: Kneel with your feet anchored, lower slowly with straight hips

126.cue: Hips up, heels toward your butt

127.cue: Push through your heels, tuck your pelvis at the top

128.cue: Extend from your hip, not your back

131.cue: Full stretch at the bottom with a 1–2 s pause, knees straight

132.cue: Balls of your feet on the edge, deep stretch

134.cue: Hold on for support, full range

138.cue: Hang for time, pinch two plates together

139.cue: Head off the bench, light weights and high reps

142.cue: Push your head into your hand in 4 directions × 10–20 s

1001.cue: Keep your back on the pad and feet mid-platform; sink deep under control, then drive up through the whole foot.
1001.err: Loading too much and cutting depth short — the machine is made for a deep knee bend.

1002.m: Quads, Glutes, Spinal erectors, Abs, Biceps, Adductors
1002.cue: Cradle the bar in the crook of your elbows, chest tall and elbows up; squat between your knees and stand without letting the upper back round.
1002.err: Letting the elbows drop so the bar pulls you forward and rounds the back.

1003.m: Quads, Glutes, Adductors, Spinal erectors, Abs
1003.cue: Set the safety pins at your bottom position and start each rep from a dead stop on the pins; brace hard, then drive up explosively.
1003.err: Getting under the bar loose — brace and tighten your back before you push off the pins.

1004.m: Quads, Glutes, Spinal erectors, Traps, Adductors, Abs
1004.cue: Hold the handles lightly, push your upper back into the pads and keep the chest up as the bar tries to tip you forward.
1004.err: Folding forward out of the bottom; the SSB punishes a weak upper back.

1005.cue: With the safety bar on your back, hold the rack or handles in front for balance and sit straight down, using your hands only as much as needed.
1005.err: Pulling hard with the arms so the legs do less work.

1006.m: Quads, Glutes, Front delt, Traps, Abs, Spinal erectors, Adductors
1006.cue: Lock a wide-grip bar overhead with active shoulders, keep it over mid-foot and squat deep with a tall chest.
1006.err: Letting the bar drift forward because of tight hips or shoulders — start with a PVC pipe.

1007.cue: Feet shoulder-width, sit hips back and down until thighs reach parallel, knees tracking over toes, then stand tall.
1007.err: Heels lifting and knees caving in.

1008.cue: Stand in front of a bench, sit back until you lightly touch it, then stand up without rocking or using momentum.
1008.err: Plopping down and rocking forward to get up.

1009.cue: Wide stance with toes turned out, hold one dumbbell hanging between your legs; sit straight down, pushing knees out over toes.
1009.err: Knees collapsing inward and the torso tipping forward.

1010.cue: Rest the bar on your front delts with elbows high, feet slightly forward; squat deep keeping the torso upright.
1010.err: Elbows dropping so the bar rolls toward the fingers.

1011.cue: Place feet a step in front of the bar and lean back into it; sit down deep, letting the knees travel forward, then press up.
1011.err: Feet too far forward so the heels lift or the low back rounds at the bottom.

1012.m: Quads, Glutes, Abs, Spinal erectors, Adductors
1012.cue: Hold two bells in the rack position, wrists straight and elbows tucked; squat deep keeping the chest proud.
1012.err: Letting the bells pull the chest down and round the upper back.

1013.m: Quads, Glutes, Traps, Forearm flexors, Adductors
1013.cue: Hold dumbbells at your sides with straight arms, squat to parallel or below and stand up without letting them swing.
1013.err: Leaning forward to make room for the dumbbells instead of sitting down between the legs.

1014.cue: Loop a heavy band behind your knees anchored to a post, lean back into it and squat with shins vertical, holding the bottom if needed.
1014.err: Band too light, so you can't sit back and the knees drift forward.

1015.cue: Slide down a wall until knees are about 90°, back flat on the wall and weight in the heels; hold and breathe.
1015.err: Resting hands on the thighs to take the load off.

1016.cue: Dip to a quarter or half squat and jump as high as you can, landing softly through the balls of the feet into the next rep.
1016.err: Landing stiff-legged with knees caving in.

1017.cue: Place one foot centered on the platform, lower until the knee is near your chest without the hips lifting, then press through the heel.
1017.err: Knee drifting inward and the pelvis twisting off the seat.

1018.cue: Set feet high and wider than shoulders with toes slightly out; lower deep while keeping the tailbone on the seat, push through the heels.
1018.err: Going so deep the lower back peels off the pad.

1019.cue: Feet low on the platform, about hip-width; let the knees travel well forward over the toes for a deep quad stretch, keep heels down.
1019.err: Heels lifting off the platform at the bottom.

1020.cue: Sit with back against the pad, feet mid-plate; bend the knees to about 90° and push the plate away without locking the knees.
1020.err: Snapping the knees straight at the top.

1021.cue: Lie flat under the sled with hips under the platform; lower slowly toward your chest and press straight up.
1021.err: Hips curling up off the floor at the bottom.

1022.cue: Face the back pad with your chest against it, hinge hips back as you descend and drive up through the heels squeezing the glutes.
1022.err: Rounding the lower back at the bottom.

1023.cue: Shoulders under the pads, feet mid-platform; descend to at least parallel with an upright torso and drive back up.
1023.err: Doing short half reps with heavy weight.

1024.cue: Work one leg at a time, extend fully and squeeze the quad for a second at the top, then lower slowly.
1024.err: Kicking the weight up and letting it drop.

1025.cue: Lock your ankles under the rollers and shins against the pad; lean back and bend at the knees keeping hips extended, then return.
1025.err: Bending at the hips, which turns it into a normal squat.

1026.cue: Loop a band behind the knee anchored in front, start slightly bent and straighten the knee fully against the band, squeezing the quad.
1026.err: Moving the hips back and forth instead of straightening the knee.

1027.cue: Step forward, drop the back knee toward the floor with the front shin near vertical, then push off the front foot back to standing.
1027.err: Taking a short step so the front heel lifts and the knee takes all the load.

1028.cue: Step one leg diagonally behind the other, lower with hips square to the front, then drive through the front heel to stand.
1028.err: Twisting the hips and letting the front knee cave in.

1029.cue: Stand on a low step, step back and lower until the back knee nearly touches the floor, getting a deep hip stretch; drive up through the front heel.
1029.err: Using too high a step and losing balance or depth control.

1030.cue: Set a long split stance under the bar, drop straight down until the back knee nearly touches the floor, then press up through the front foot.
1030.err: Stance too short so the front heel rises.

1031.cue: Rear foot on a bench behind you, bar on your back; lower under control until the front thigh is parallel, then drive up.
1031.err: Pushing off the back leg instead of the front.

1032.cue: Unrack, step one leg back and lower until the back knee nearly touches, then return the foot and stand; alternate or repeat one side.
1032.err: Starting with feet too far forward of the bar, putting strain on the knee.

1033.cue: Put the front foot on a plate or low step to allow extra depth; sink until the back knee touches lightly, then drive up.
1033.err: Elevating too high and losing a neutral spine at the bottom.

1034.cue: Hold the bar end at your chest with both hands, step back into a lunge and drive through the front foot to return.
1034.err: Leaning far forward so the bar pulls you off balance.

1035.cue: Stand side-on to a box, plant the near foot on top and stand up through that heel; lower slowly with control.
1035.err: Pushing off the floor leg instead of the leg on the box.

1036.cue: Stand beside the box, cross the far leg over onto it and stand up through that foot, keeping hips level.
1036.err: Rotating the torso and hiking the hip.

1037.cue: From a lunge, jump up and switch legs in the air, landing softly in a lunge on the other side.
1037.err: Landing with the back knee slamming the floor.

1038.cue: Hold the rear foot behind you with one hand, lower until the back knee touches the floor, then stand without the knee bouncing.
1038.err: Crashing down onto the knee with no control.

1039.cue: Stand on one leg in front of a box, reach arms forward and sit back to touch the box, then stand on the same leg.
1039.err: Dropping onto the box and rocking to stand.

1040.cue: Stand on a step on one leg, slowly lower the other heel to tap the floor beside it, keeping the standing knee over the toes, then rise.

1041.m: Quads, Glutes, Glute med, Abs, Hip flexors
1041.cue: Hold straps or a pole, extend one leg forward and squat as deep as you can on the other, using arms only to help balance and the bottom.
1041.err: Pulling up with the arms so the leg barely works.

1042.m: Hamstrings, Glutes, Spinal erectors, Glute med
1042.cue: Put most weight on the front leg with the back toe lightly down beside the heel; hinge back with a flat back until you feel the hamstring stretch, then drive hips forward.
1042.err: Shifting weight onto the back foot so it becomes a normal RDL.

1043.m: Glutes, Hamstrings, Spinal erectors, Traps, Rhomboids, Lats, Quads, Forearm flexors
1043.cue: Take a very wide grip, sit hips lower than a normal pull, pull the slack out and push the floor away keeping the bar close.
1043.err: Upper back rounding because of the long range of motion.

1044.m: Glutes, Hamstrings, Spinal erectors, Quads, Traps, Lats
1044.cue: Pull the bar just off the floor (or to below the knee), hold 1–2 seconds without moving, then finish the lift.
1044.err: Hips shooting up during the pause so the back takes over.

1045.m: Glutes, Hamstrings, Quads, Spinal erectors, Forearm flexors
1045.cue: Stand over the bell, push hips back with a flat back and grab it; drive through the floor and stand tall squeezing the glutes.
1045.err: Rounding the back to reach the weight instead of bending the hips.

1046.cue: Hold a stick along your spine touching head, upper back and tailbone; push hips back with soft knees while keeping all three contacts.
1046.err: Bending the knees into a squat instead of pushing hips back.
1046.easy: Wall hip hinge (tap hips to wall)

1047.m: Glutes, Obliques, Hamstrings, Quads, Spinal erectors, Forearm flexors
1047.cue: Hold one weight at your side, hinge and squat down to it, then stand up without leaning or twisting toward the weight.

1048.cue: Stand close to the bar, soft knees, push hips back sliding the bar down the thighs until a strong hamstring stretch, then drive hips forward.
1048.err: Standing too far back so the fixed bar path pulls you forward.

1049.m: Hamstrings, Glutes, Spinal erectors, Forearm flexors
1049.cue: Straddle or stand facing the bar end holding it with both hands; hinge back with a flat back and stand by squeezing the glutes.
1049.err: Squatting the weight down instead of hinging.

1050.cue: Stand on the band and loop it behind your neck/upper back; hinge forward with a flat back and soft knees, then stand tall against the band.
1050.err: Rounding the back as you lean forward.

1051.cue: Upper back on a bench, dumbbell on your hips; drive through the heels until the torso is level, chin tucked, and squeeze for a second.
1051.err: Arching the lower back at the top instead of finishing with the glutes.

1052.cue: Set the bench so the bar lands over your hip crease with a pad; drive up to full hip extension, hold briefly and lower under control.
1052.err: Feet too far out so the hamstrings take over.

1053.cue: Back on the pad and belt across the hips; push through heels to full lockout, squeeze the glutes, then lower slowly.
1053.err: Hyperextending the low back to move more weight.

1054.cue: Upper back on a bench, one foot planted and the other knee pulled in; drive through the heel to full extension keeping the pelvis level.
1054.err: Pelvis dropping or rotating to one side.

1055.cue: Lie on your back, soles of feet together and knees out; pull heels close and thrust the hips up, squeezing the glutes hard.
1055.err: Pushing with the lower back instead of the glutes.

1056.cue: Lie on your back with one foot planted and the other leg straight; drive through the heel to lift the hips, keeping them level.
1056.err: Hips tilting toward the raised leg.

1057.cue: Hips on the pad, body horizontal; lower the torso to hang down, then raise it back to parallel without swinging past it.
1057.err: Swinging up and hyperextending the low back at the top.

1058.cue: Set the pad low on the hips, turn toes out and round the upper back slightly; drive up by squeezing the glutes, stopping in a straight line.
1058.err: Pad too high so the hips can't hinge and the low back does the work.

1059.m: Glutes, Hamstrings, Spinal erectors, Glute med
1059.cue: Hook one foot under the roller with the other leg free; lower with control and rise with that single glute and hamstring.
1059.err: Twisting the hips toward the free leg.

1060.cue: Knees just behind the pad, feet locked; from horizontal, curl your body up with the hamstrings until upright, keeping hips extended.
1060.err: Bending at the hips so it turns into a back extension.

1061.m: Glutes, Hamstrings, Obliques, Spinal erectors, Forearm flexors, Front delt
1061.cue: Hike the bell back between the legs and snap the hips forward to float it to chest height; resist the rotation with your core.
1061.err: Lifting with the arm and letting the shoulder get pulled forward.

1062.cue: Face away from a low anchor with the band between your legs; hinge back letting the band pull your hands through, then snap hips forward.
1062.err: Pulling with the arms instead of driving with the hips.

1063.cue: Pad just above the heel, hips pressed into the support; curl the heel toward your glute, squeeze, and lower slowly.
1063.err: Hips swinging back to help lift the weight.

1064.cue: Face the low pulley with the strap on your ankle, hold the frame, keep thighs in line and curl the heel up toward the glute.
1064.err: Letting the thigh drift forward so the hip flexor helps.

1065.cue: Lie face down with a dumbbell squeezed between your feet; curl it up to about 90° and lower slowly, keeping hips on the bench.
1065.err: Going past 90° where the dumbbell can slip out — use a partner to place it.

1066.cue: Lie face down with a band anchored low around your ankles; curl heels toward glutes against the band and return slowly.
1066.err: Lifting the hips off the floor.

1067.cue: Kneel with ankles held, band from above looped around your chest; lower forward as slowly as possible with hips straight, then pull back up.
1067.err: Bending at the hips to shorten the lever.

1068.cue: Stand side-on to a low pulley, strap on the outer ankle; sweep the leg out to the side without leaning, and return slowly.
1068.err: Leaning the torso away and swinging the leg.

1069.cue: Stand side-on with the strap on the near ankle; pull the leg across in front of the standing leg and return under control.
1069.err: Rotating the hips to get more range.

1070.cue: Band above knees or around ankles, half-squat with tension on the band; take small side steps without letting the feet come together.
1070.err: Standing up straight and letting the band go slack.

1071.cue: Lie on your side, bottom knee bent; lift the straight top leg slightly behind the body with toes pointing forward, then lower slowly.
1071.err: Rolling the hips back and lifting with the hip flexor (toes to ceiling).

1072.cue: Lie on your side with hips and knees bent and feet together; open the top knee like a clam without rolling the pelvis back.
1072.err: Rolling the pelvis open instead of rotating at the hip.

1073.cue: On hands and knees, lift one bent leg out to the side to hip height keeping the torso still, then lower.
1073.err: Shifting weight and tilting the whole body to lift the leg.

1074.cue: Lie on your side, cross the top leg over in front; lift the straight bottom leg off the floor, pause and lower.
1074.err: Rolling backward instead of staying stacked on the side.

1075.cue: Lie on your back, knees bent, ball between the knees; squeeze hard for 5–10 seconds, relax and repeat.
1075.err: Holding your breath during the squeeze.

1076.cue: Chest on the pad, foot on the plate; drive the leg back and up by squeezing the glute, stop before the low back arches, return slowly.
1076.err: Arching the lower back to kick higher.

1077.cue: On hands and knees, keep the knee bent 90° and press the sole of the foot toward the ceiling until the thigh is level with the body.
1077.err: Sagging the lower back to lift the leg higher.

1078.cue: Anchor a band low (or loop it around both feet), hinge slightly and kick one leg straight back, squeezing the glute at the end.
1078.err: Swinging the leg with momentum and arching the back.

1079.cue: Hinge at the hips with the pad on your lower back, balls of feet on the step; drop the heels into a deep stretch, pause, then rise as high as possible.
1079.err: Bouncing out of the bottom instead of pausing in the stretch.

1080.cue: Bar on your upper back, balls of feet on a plate or step; lower heels fully, pause, and press up onto the big toe.
1080.err: Bending the knees to push the weight up.

1081.cue: Stand in the hack squat with balls of feet on the platform edge and knees almost straight; lower heels slowly and rise high.
1081.err: Using a short, fast range with no stretch.

1082.cue: Lean your back on a wall with heels about a foot away; pull the toes up as high as possible, pause, and lower slowly.
1082.err: Moving the hips back and forth instead of moving at the ankle.

1083.cue: Sit on a bench edge with a tib bar or dumbbell over your feet; let the toes drop, then pull them up toward the shins and pause.
1083.err: Using too much weight and only moving a few degrees.

1084.cue: Stay tall with nearly straight knees and bounce quickly off the balls of the feet, minimizing ground contact time.
1084.err: Landing on the heels and bending the knees a lot.

1085.cue: Knee bent 90° under the pad (or dumbbell on the knee), ball of one foot on the step; lower to a full stretch and rise high.
1085.err: Rolling onto the outer edge of the foot.

1086.cue: Set the bench so the bar touches your mid-chest. Unrack with a twist, lower under control, press up without locking hard.
1086.err: Bench placed wrong, so the bar hits the neck or belly.

1087.cue: Lock your legs under the pad on a decline bench. Lower the bar to the lower chest and press straight up.
1087.err: Bouncing the bar off the chest.

1088.cue: On a 15–30° decline, press the dumbbells over the lower chest, elbows about 45° from your body.
1088.err: Flaring elbows straight out to the sides.

1089.cue: Set the bench to about 15°. Lower the dumbbells to the upper chest with a deep stretch, then press up and slightly in.
1089.err: Cutting the range short at the bottom.

1090.cue: Palms face each other, elbows tucked close to the body. Lower to the chest and press up — easy on the shoulders.
1090.err: Letting the dumbbells drift apart at the bottom.

1091.cue: Press one dumbbell while the other hand holds the bench. Brace your core so your body does not roll toward the weight.
1091.err: Hips and shoulders rotating off the bench.

1092.cue: Press two dumbbells together hard over your chest the whole set. Lower to the chest and press up while squeezing.

1093.cue: Grip wider than usual (within legal 81 cm rings). Shorter range, more chest. Keep shoulder blades pinched.
1093.err: Going so wide the shoulders hurt.

1094.cue: Underhand grip slightly wider than shoulders. Always use a spotter. Lower to the lower chest, elbows tucked.
1094.err: Training it heavy without a spotter.

1095.cue: Bench press with legs straight and raised off the floor. No leg drive — the chest and core do all the work.
1095.err: Losing balance and twisting on the bench.

1096.cue: Set the seat so the handles line up with your upper chest. Press up and forward, return slowly to a full stretch.
1096.err: Seat too low so it becomes a shoulder press.

1097.cue: Sit tall, chest up. Press the handles down and forward, then let them come back until you feel a stretch.
1097.err: Shrugging the shoulders up during the press.

1098.cue: Each arm moves on its own. Keep shoulder blades back on the pad and press both handles evenly, or one at a time.
1098.err: Weak arm lagging and the strong side doing more.

1099.cue: Handles start at upper-chest height. Drive up and slightly together, control the lowering for 2–3 seconds.
1099.err: Arching the lower back off the seat.

1100.cue: Press down and forward in an arc toward your lower chest line. Keep chest proud and wrists stacked.

1101.cue: Stand in a split stance between the pulleys, handles at chest height. Press forward until arms are straight, brace your core.
1101.err: Leaning the whole body forward instead of pressing.

1102.cue: On a 30° bench, open the arms in a wide arc with a soft elbow bend until you feel a stretch, then hug back up.
1102.err: Bending the elbows so it turns into a press.

1103.cue: On a light decline, lower the dumbbells out to the sides with soft elbows, then bring them together over the lower chest.
1103.err: Using weights too heavy to control the stretch.

1104.cue: Pulleys set high. Step forward, sweep the handles down and together in front of your hips. Targets the lower chest.
1104.err: Rounding the shoulders forward at the finish.

1105.cue: Pulleys set low. Sweep the handles up and together to chin height, palms up. Targets the upper chest.
1105.err: Turning it into a front raise with straight arms and shrugging.

1106.cue: Stand side-on to the pulley. Sweep one arm across your body past the midline for a full squeeze, resisting the twist.
1106.err: Rotating the torso to finish the rep.

1107.cue: Place an incline bench between low pulleys. Fly the handles over your upper chest — constant tension at the top.
1107.err: Letting the handles yank the arms too far back.

1108.cue: Squeeze one or two plates between your palms at chest height. Press straight out, keep squeezing, and bring back.
1108.err: Relaxing the squeeze so it becomes a front raise.

1109.cue: Hold the bar end with both hands at chest, palms pressing inward. Press up and out in an arc, squeezing the chest.
1109.err: Leaning back and turning it into a shoulder press.

1110.cue: Kneel on the pad, lean slightly forward and lower until the upper arms are about parallel, then push up. More weight = more help.
1110.err: Going too deep and letting shoulders roll forward.

1111.cue: Hang a plate or dumbbell from a dip belt. Lean forward, lower under control to a comfortable depth, press up strongly.
1111.err: Adding load before owning 15 clean bodyweight dips.

1112.m: Chest, Triceps, Front delt, Biceps, Abs
1112.cue: Start in a locked support with rings turned out. Lower with rings close to the body, then press back to lockout.
1112.err: Rings drifting wide, which strains the shoulders.

1113.cue: Keep your torso vertical and elbows pointing back. Lower until elbows reach about 90°, then lock out.
1113.err: Elbows flaring out to the sides.

1114.cue: Sit with back on the pad, grip the handles beside you. Push down until arms are straight, return until elbows hit 90°.
1114.err: Leaning forward and using the chest to push.

1115.cue: Hands on a bench, body in one straight line. Lower your chest to the edge and push away. Lower the surface to progress.

1116.cue: Knees on the floor, straight line from knees to head. Lower your chest between your hands and push up.
1116.err: Bending at the hips and pushing only the head down.

1117.cue: Hands about 1.5× shoulder width. Lower chest to the floor with elbows at ~60°, push up.
1117.err: Placing hands so wide the range gets tiny.

1118.cue: Feet on a bench, hands on the floor. Keep the body rigid and lower your upper chest toward the floor.

1119.cue: Hands on plates or handles so the chest can sink below hand level. Lower slowly into the stretch, push up.
1119.err: Dropping fast into the bottom and losing tension.

1120.cue: Very wide hands. Shift down toward one hand while the other arm stays straight, push back up. Alternate sides.
1120.err: Bending the straight arm, turning it into a normal wide push-up.

1121.cue: Lower quickly, explode up so your hands leave the floor, clap, and land with soft elbows straight into the next rep.

1122.m: Chest, Triceps, Front delt, Serratus, Abs
1122.cue: Rings a few cm off the floor. Lower with rings close to your ribs, push up and turn the rings out at the top.
1122.err: Letting the rings wobble out wide.

1123.cue: A partner places a plate on your upper back, or wear a vest. Same strict push-up: body straight, chest to floor.
1123.err: Plate sliding down to the lower back, causing sag.

1124.cue: Loop a band across your upper back and pin the ends under your hands. Push hard to lockout against the band.
1124.err: Shortening the top of the rep where the band is hardest.

1125.m: Chest, Front delt, Triceps, Serratus, Abs, Biceps
1125.cue: Hands by your waist, fingers turned out, lean your shoulders well past your hands. Keep that lean as you lower and press.
1125.err: Losing the forward lean as you push up.

1126.m: Chest, Triceps, Front delt, Obliques, Abs
1126.cue: Feet wide, one hand under the chest, other hand behind your back. Lower with hips square and push up.
1126.err: Twisting the hips to cheat up.

1127.m: Front delt, Triceps, Side delt, Traps, Abs
1127.cue: Dumbbells at shoulder height, glutes and abs tight. Press overhead until arms are straight, lower to the shoulders.
1127.err: Leaning back and arching the lower back.

1128.m: Front delt, Triceps, Side delt, Traps
1128.cue: Sit upright with your back on the pad. Press the bar from the upper chest to overhead, moving your head back slightly to clear it.
1128.err: Lowering only to the forehead (half reps).

1129.cue: Set the bench just behind the bar so it travels in front of your face. Lower to chin level, press to near lockout.
1129.err: Bench too far forward, bar hits the face or forces a behind-neck path.

1130.m: Front delt, Side delt, Triceps, Traps
1130.cue: Only if you have good shoulder mobility. Lower the bar behind the head to ear level, with a light load, and press up.
1130.err: Forcing the neck forward and going too deep.

1131.m: Front delt, Side delt, Triceps, Traps
1131.cue: Press the bar just over your head from front to back and back again, never locking out. Constant tension on the delts.
1131.err: Going too heavy and losing the smooth path.

1132.m: Front delt, Triceps, Obliques, Side delt
1132.cue: Standing, press one dumbbell overhead without leaning to the side. The free hand can rest on your stomach to feel the brace.

1133.m: Front delt, Triceps, Side delt, Abs, Obliques
1133.cue: Start with the bell in the rack, forearm vertical. Press up in a slight arc, finish with biceps by the ear.
1133.err: Wrist bending back and bell flopping.

1134.m: Front delt, Chest, Triceps, Serratus, Obliques
1134.cue: Kneel on the same side as the working arm. Press the bar end up and forward, reaching at the top. Squeeze the glute of the down knee.
1134.err: Arching the back to push the bar higher.

1135.cue: Set the seat so handles start just above shoulder height. Press up, then lower with control to the start.
1135.err: Seat too high, cutting the range.

1136.m: Front delt, Triceps, Side delt, Traps
1136.cue: Face away from the landmine with a handle on the bar end. Press both handles up from shoulder height to full lockout.
1136.err: Using the legs to bounce the weight up.

1137.cue: Sit on the bench edge, dumbbells by your sides. Raise out to shoulder height leading with the elbows, lower slowly.
1137.err: Swinging the torso — seated removes that, so keep strict.

1138.cue: Lie on your side on an incline bench. Raise the top dumbbell from in front of the hips up to about vertical. Hardest at the bottom.
1138.err: Using a dumbbell too heavy for the stretched start.

1139.m: Side delt, Traps, Front delt, Supraspinatus
1139.cue: Cross the cables from two low pulleys. Raise your arms up and out into a Y shape, thumbs up, to just above head height.
1139.err: Shrugging the shoulders to the ears.

1140.cue: Stand on the band, hold the ends at your sides. Raise out to shoulder height, pause, lower slowly.
1140.err: Letting the band snap the arms down.

1141.cue: Stand side-on to the landmine, hold the bar end in the far hand across your body. Raise it out and up to shoulder height.
1141.err: Rotating the torso to swing it up.

1142.m: Front delt, Side delt, Supraspinatus, Serratus, Traps
1142.cue: Raise light dumbbells at a 30° angle in front of your body (between front and side), thumbs up, to shoulder height.
1142.err: Going heavy — this is a shoulder-health move.

1143.cue: Raise the dumbbells in front of you to shoulder height with a soft elbow, then lower slowly. Alternate or both together.
1143.err: Swinging with the hips and going above the head.

1144.cue: Hold a plate at 3 and 9 o'clock. Raise to eye level with straight arms, lower under control.

1145.cue: Face away from a low pulley, handle between your legs. Raise to shoulder height in front, lower slowly against the cable.
1145.err: Rocking the body to start the rep.

1146.m: Front delt, Side delt, Traps, Chest
1146.cue: Shoulder-width overhand grip. Raise the bar to eye level with nearly straight arms, lower in 2–3 seconds.
1146.err: Using momentum from the lower back.

1147.m: Rear delt, Rhomboids, Traps, Rotator cuff, Biceps
1147.cue: Chest on an incline bench, arms hanging. Row with elbows flared wide to about 90°, pulling toward the upper chest, not the hips.
1147.err: Tucking the elbows so the lats take over.

1148.m: Rotator cuff, Rear delt, Side delt, Traps, Supraspinatus
1148.cue: Upright row light dumbbells to elbows at shoulder height, rotate forearms up to vertical, then press overhead. Reverse to return.
1148.err: Using weights too heavy for the rotator cuff.

1149.m: Side delt, Traps, Front delt, Biceps
1149.cue: Pull the dumbbells up along your body, elbows leading, until elbows reach shoulder height. Don't go higher.
1149.err: Pulling the elbows above the shoulders and pinching.

1150.m: Rotator cuff, Teres major, Rear delt
1150.cue: Pulley at elbow height, elbow pinned to your side at 90°. Rotate the forearm outward, keeping the elbow still.
1150.err: Elbow drifting away from the body.

1151.m: Rotator cuff, Teres major, Rear delt
1151.cue: Lie on your side, top elbow bent 90° on your hip (a towel under it helps). Rotate the dumbbell up, then lower slowly.
1151.err: Rolling the body back to lift it higher.

1152.cue: Stand tall holding the bar at arm's length. Lift the shoulders straight up to the ears, hold 1 second, lower fully.

1153.cue: Stand inside the trap bar with neutral grip. Shrug straight up, pause, and lower to a full stretch. Allows heavy loads.
1153.err: Bending the elbows to help lift.

1154.cue: Hold a straight bar or two handles from low pulleys. Shrug up and slightly back, pause, lower slowly.
1154.err: Jerking the weight with the legs.

1155.cue: Hold the bar behind your thighs with an overhand grip. Shrug up and slightly back, keeping arms straight.
1155.err: Leaning forward and rounding the upper back.

1156.cue: Lock the bar overhead with arms straight. Shrug your shoulders up toward the ears, then lower without bending the elbows.
1156.err: Arching the lower back under the bar.

1157.cue: Stand tall, elbows by your sides. Curl one dumbbell while turning the palm up, squeeze, lower fully, then switch.
1157.err: Elbows drifting forward and swinging the body.

1158.cue: Set the seat so your armpits sit snug on the pad top. Curl up, squeeze, and lower to almost straight arms.
1158.err: Seat too low so shoulders lift off the pad.

1159.cue: Put a preacher bench in front of a low pulley. Curl the bar or handle up — the cable keeps tension at the top.
1159.err: Letting the weight stack crash at the bottom.

1160.cue: Lie back on a 45–60° bench, arms hanging. Curl with palms facing each other, keeping elbows behind your torso.
1160.err: Lifting the shoulders off the bench.

1161.cue: Neutral grip; curl the dumbbell up and across toward the opposite shoulder. Lower the same way.

1162.cue: Rope on a low pulley, palms facing in. Curl up and pull the rope ends apart at the top, lower slowly.
1162.err: Leaning back to finish the rep.

1163.cue: Pull your elbows back as you curl, dragging the bar up along your torso to the lower chest. Lower the same way.
1163.err: Letting the bar drift away from the body.

1164.cue: Curl up with palms facing up, rotate to palms down at the top, then lower slowly with the overhand grip.
1164.err: Rushing the lowering phase — that's the point of the move.

1165.cue: Stand between two high pulleys, arms out at shoulder height. Curl the handles toward your ears, keeping elbows high.
1165.err: Dropping the elbows so it becomes a row.

1166.cue: Lie on the floor with feet toward a low pulley, upper arms vertical. Curl the bar toward your forehead, elbows fixed.
1166.err: Moving the upper arms back and forth.

1167.cue: Hold one dumbbell vertically by the top plate, palms cupped under it. Curl up keeping it level, like carrying a tray.
1167.err: Letting the elbows flare out wide.

1168.cue: 7 reps bottom-to-halfway, 7 reps halfway-to-top, then 7 full reps — no rest between. Use a lighter bar.
1168.err: Starting too heavy and swinging the last 7.

1169.cue: Stand on the band, hold the ends palms up. Curl up, squeeze hard at the top where tension is highest, lower slowly.
1169.err: Letting the band pull the arms down fast.

1170.cue: Use a small hip drive to get a heavier bar up, then lower very slowly (3–4 s) with strict form. Lower back stays neutral.
1170.err: Big back swings and dropping the bar fast.

1171.cue: Elbows pinned to your sides. Push the rope down and spread the ends apart at the bottom, then let it rise to 90°.
1171.err: Elbows moving forward and shoulders rolling in.

1172.cue: Underhand grip on a straight bar. Push down to straight arms with elbows locked at your sides, control the way up.
1172.err: Wrists bending back under the load.

1173.cue: Use a D-handle, elbow tight to your side. Extend the arm fully, squeeze, and return slowly. Fixes left/right imbalance.
1173.err: Leaning over the handle to push with bodyweight.

1174.cue: Seated or standing, hold the dumbbell overhead. Lower behind your head keeping the elbow pointing up, then extend.
1174.err: Elbow flaring out to the side.

1175.cue: Pulley at shoulder height, grab with the far hand. Extend the arm out to the side across your body until straight.
1175.err: Moving the upper arm instead of the forearm.

1176.cue: On a 30° bench, lower the EZ bar behind your head with upper arms angled back, then extend. Big long-head stretch.
1176.err: Elbows flaring wide as the weight gets heavy.

1177.cue: On a decline bench, lower the bar toward your forehead with elbows pointing up, then extend to straight arms.
1177.err: Letting the bar drift over the chest so it becomes a press.

1178.cue: Lie on a bench with your head toward a low pulley. Extend the bar or rope from behind your head to over your chest.
1178.err: Pulling with the lats by moving the upper arms.

1179.cue: Lie on a bench, dumbbells over your chest, palms facing your feet. Bend elbows outward so the dumbbells touch your chest, then extend.
1179.err: Dropping the dumbbells hard onto the chest.

1180.cue: Lower the dumbbells beside your head, let the elbows roll back slightly, then roll them forward and press to lockout.
1180.err: Turning it into a dumbbell bench press.

1181.cue: Elbows on the pad lined up with the machine pivot. Extend fully, squeeze, and return until forearms pass 90°.

1182.cue: Hands on a bar at hip height, body straight. Bend only the elbows to lower your forehead under the bar, then extend.
1182.err: Hips sagging and turning it into a push-up.

1183.cue: Hold a bar behind your thighs, palms facing back. Let it roll to your fingertips, then curl the wrists up.
1183.err: Bending the elbows or shrugging to lift it.

1184.m: Forearm flexors, Forearm extensors, Brachioradialis, Front delt
1184.cue: Arms straight out in front. Roll the rope up by turning the handle one hand at a time, then unroll slowly. Do both directions.
1184.err: Letting the arms drop and using the shoulders.

1185.cue: Pick up heavy weights and stand tall, shoulders down, crushing the handles for time. No walking needed.
1185.err: Letting the shoulders shrug up and round forward.

1186.cue: Drape two towels over a pull-up bar and hang from them with a tight grip for time. Builds a crushing grip.

1187.cue: Squeeze the gripper until the handles touch, hold 1–2 seconds, release slowly. Pick a strength you can close 8–12 times.

1188.m: Brachioradialis, Forearm flexors, Forearm extensors, Biceps
1188.cue: Forearm resting on your thigh or bench, hold one end of a dumbbell. Slowly rotate palm up, then palm down.
1188.err: Moving the elbow instead of rotating the forearm.

1189.m: Lats, Teres major, Rhomboids, Biceps, Rear delt
1189.cue: Grip just outside shoulder width, chest up, and pull the bar to your upper chest by driving the elbows down and back.
1189.err: Leaning far back and yanking with momentum, turning it into a row.

1190.m: Lats, Biceps, Brachialis, Rhomboids, Teres major
1190.cue: Palms facing you at shoulder width; pull the bar to your lower chest keeping elbows close to your sides.
1190.err: Pulling only with the biceps and not finishing with the elbows behind the torso.

1191.m: Lats, Teres major, Brachialis, Biceps, Rhomboids
1191.cue: Hold the parallel handles with palms facing each other, keep a slight lean back and pull until the handle reaches your upper chest.
1191.err: Shrugging the shoulders up at the top instead of letting the lats stretch with shoulders down.

1192.m: Lats, Teres major, Rhomboids, Traps, Rear delt
1192.cue: Only if you have excellent shoulder mobility: light weight, head slightly forward, lower the bar to the base of the skull—not lower.
1192.err: Going heavy and jamming the bar down onto the neck, stressing the shoulder joint; front pulldown is safer for most people.

1193.cue: Lock your thighs under the pad and pull the handles down in an arc toward your sides; you can work one arm at a time.
1193.err: Letting the weight yank the arms up fast and losing the stretch control.

1194.cue: Anchor the band high (door or bar), kneel, and pull the ends down to your sides, squeezing the shoulder blades down.
1194.err: Letting the band snap back instead of controlling the return.

1195.m: Lats, Teres major, Chest, Triceps, Serratus
1195.cue: Lie on a bench with your head toward a low cable, arms nearly straight, and pull the bar in an arc from behind your head to over your hips.
1195.err: Bending the elbows a lot and turning it into a triceps extension.

1196.cue: Set the seat so shoulders line up with the machine pivot, press with the elbows (not hands) and bring the bar down to your stomach.
1196.err: Seat set wrong so the shoulders pinch and the range is cut short.

1197.m: Lats, Chest, Teres major, Triceps, Serratus
1197.cue: Lying on a bench, hold the bar over your chest with soft elbows, lower it behind your head until you feel a lat stretch, then pull it back over the chest.
1197.err: Arching the lower back off the bench and going too heavy for the shoulders.

1198.m: Lats, Teres major, Rhomboids, Biceps, Brachialis
1198.cue: Grip about 1.5× shoulder width, start from a dead hang with shoulders engaged, and pull your chest toward the bar.
1198.err: Half reps—not starting from full hang or chin never clearing the bar.

1199.cue: Kneel on the pad, choose assistance (more weight = easier), and pull until chin passes the handles, then lower slowly.
1199.err: Using so much assistance that it never gets lighter over the weeks.

1200.m: Lats, Traps, Rhomboids, Teres major, Forearm flexors
1200.cue: Hang with straight arms and, without bending the elbows, pull the shoulder blades down and back to lift your body a few centimetres.
1200.err: Bending the arms and doing a mini pull-up instead of moving the shoulder blades.

1201.cue: Stand under the bar, use a small jump to help you reach the top, then lower yourself as slowly as you can.
1201.err: Jumping too hard so the arms do no work, and dropping down fast.

1202.m: Lats, Teres major, Biceps, Brachialis, Rhomboids
1202.cue: Hang a plate or dumbbell from a dip belt, keep legs still and pull with full range—chin over bar, full hang at the bottom.
1202.err: Adding weight before owning 8–10 strict bodyweight reps, then cutting range short.

1203.m: Lats, Biceps, Brachialis, Teres major, Rhomboids
1203.cue: Underhand shoulder-width grip with added load; pull until the chin clears the bar and lower under control to a full hang.
1203.err: Kicking the legs and craning the neck to 'get the chin over'.

1204.cue: Stand beside the bar and grip it with hands close, one in front of the other; pull up bringing your head to one side, alternate sides each rep.
1204.err: Twisting the body wildly instead of pulling straight up.

1205.m: Lats, Biceps, Teres major, Rhomboids, Forearm flexors
1205.cue: Take a very wide grip and pull toward one hand while the other arm straightens along the bar; lower and switch sides.
1205.err: Bending the 'straight' arm so both arms share the load equally.

1206.m: Lats, Abs, Hip flexors, Biceps, Teres major
1206.cue: Lift straight legs to hip height and hold them there while doing strict pull-ups.
1206.err: Legs dropping lower and lower as the set gets hard.

1207.m: Lats, Biceps, Teres major, Rhomboids, Rear delt
1207.cue: Pull up with a wide grip, then slide your chin from one hand to the other along the bar while staying at the top, then lower.
1207.err: Dropping below the bar during the side-to-side movement.

1208.m: Lats, Rhomboids, Traps, Biceps, Teres major
1208.cue: Pull higher than a normal pull-up until your upper chest touches the bar, leaning back slightly at the top.
1208.err: Rounding the shoulders forward to reach the bar instead of pulling the elbows down.

1209.cue: One palm forward, one palm back at shoulder width; pull straight up keeping the body square, and switch the grip each set.
1209.err: Always using the same hand forward, building an imbalance.

1210.m: Lats, Forearm flexors, Biceps, Brachioradialis, Brachialis
1210.cue: Hang two towels over the bar, grip them tightly and do strict pull-ups—this builds serious grip strength.
1210.err: Using thin, slippery towels and losing grip mid-rep.

1211.m: Lats, Hip flexors, Abs, Rear delt, Teres major
1211.cue: Swing between an arch and hollow position, then snap the hips to drive the chin over the bar; build strict pull-ups and healthy shoulders first.
1211.err: Kipping without enough strict strength, which overloads the shoulders.

1212.m: Lats, Biceps, Brachialis, Teres major, Forearm flexors, Obliques
1212.cue: Grip the bar with one hand and hold a towel lower down with the other for help; pull up mostly with the bar arm and reduce help over time.
1212.err: Rotating the body and pulling hard with the assisting hand.

1213.m: Lats, Biceps, Teres major, Traps, Rhomboids
1213.cue: From a dead hang, pull as fast and high as possible so the bar reaches your lower chest or belly; this builds power for the muscle-up.
1213.err: Kipping wildly instead of generating power with the back and arms.

1214.m: Lats, Forearm flexors, Biceps, Brachialis, Abs, Brachioradialis
1214.cue: Pull with the arms and clamp the rope between your feet to lock in each new height; climb down hand-over-hand, never slide.
1214.err: Using only the arms with no foot lock, and sliding down causing rope burns.

1215.m: Lats, Triceps, Chest, Front delt, Abs, Biceps
1215.cue: Pull explosively to your hips, lean the chest over the bar as the wrists turn over, then press out to locked arms on top.
1215.err: Pulling the bar to the chin and trying to muscle over with a 'chicken wing' one arm at a time.

1216.m: Lats, Rhomboids, Traps, Biceps, Rear delt, Spinal erectors
1216.cue: Underhand grip, torso at about 45°, pull the bar to your lower stomach, leading with the elbows close to the body.
1216.err: Standing more upright every rep and turning it into a shrug.

1217.m: Rhomboids, Rear delt, Traps, Lats, Teres major, Rotator cuff, Biceps
1217.cue: Grip wider than shoulders, hinge forward, and row the bar to the lower chest with elbows flared about 45–60° to hit the upper back and rear delts.
1217.err: Rounding the lower back under load.

1218.m: Lats, Rhomboids, Traps, Rear delt, Biceps, Spinal erectors
1218.cue: Hinge forward with a flat back, palms facing in, and row both dumbbells to your hips, squeezing the shoulder blades.
1218.err: Jerking the torso up to swing the weights.

1219.m: Lats, Rhomboids, Traps, Rear delt, Biceps
1219.cue: Set the bar at knee height, hinge forward, and row it to your lower ribs; the fixed path lets you focus on squeezing the back.
1219.err: Standing too close or too far so the bar hits the thighs.

1220.m: Rhomboids, Lats, Traps, Rear delt, Biceps, Teres major
1220.cue: Lie chest-down on the pad, grab the handles and row up until the elbows pass your torso, keeping the chest glued to the pad.
1220.err: Lifting the chest off the pad to heave the weight.

1221.m: Lats, Rhomboids, Teres major, Traps, Rear delt, Biceps
1221.cue: Sit with thighs under the pad and pull the handles down and back toward your lower ribs; arms can work together or one at a time.
1221.err: Rounding forward at the stretch and losing chest position.

1222.m: Lats, Rhomboids, Traps, Rear delt, Biceps
1222.cue: Chest against the pad, pull the handles back toward your hips, driving the elbows past the torso; try single-arm sets to fix imbalances.
1222.err: Short, choppy reps without a full stretch forward.

1223.m: Rhomboids, Rear delt, Traps, Lats, Teres major, Biceps
1223.cue: Use a long bar with an overhand wide grip, sit tall, and pull to the lower chest with elbows out, squeezing the upper back.
1223.err: Rocking the torso back and forth to move the stack.

1224.m: Rhomboids, Lats, Rear delt, Traps, Biceps, Brachioradialis
1224.cue: Hold the rope with thumbs up, row to your stomach and pull the rope ends apart at the end, squeezing the shoulder blades.
1224.err: Letting the shoulders roll forward at the end of the rep.

1225.m: Lats, Biceps, Rhomboids, Teres major, Brachialis
1225.cue: Palms up on a straight bar at shoulder width; row to the belly button with elbows tight to the sides.
1225.err: Curling the bar with the arms instead of driving the elbows back.

1226.m: Lats, Rhomboids, Teres major, Biceps, Obliques
1226.cue: Row one handle to your hip while letting the shoulder reach forward on the stretch; keep the torso from twisting too much.
1226.err: Rotating the whole body to finish the rep.

1227.m: Lats, Rhomboids, Obliques, Biceps, Glute med
1227.cue: Stand in a split stance facing a chest-height cable, row the handle to your ribs and resist the twist with your core.
1227.err: Letting the hips and shoulders rotate open as you pull.

1228.m: Lats, Traps, Rhomboids, Biceps, Forearm flexors, Brachioradialis
1228.cue: A heavy, high-rep one-arm dumbbell row with a bit of controlled body English; use straps if needed and keep the back flat.
1228.err: Using so much momentum that the back barely works, or rounding the spine.

1229.m: Lats, Abs, Obliques, Rhomboids, Triceps, Front delt
1229.cue: In a push-up position on two dumbbells with feet wide, row one dumbbell to your hip without letting the hips twist, then alternate.
1229.err: Hips rotating and rising high to make the row easier.

1230.m: Rhomboids, Lats, Rear delt, Traps, Biceps
1230.cue: Stand behind an incline bench with your chest lightly resting on the top edge, and row the dumbbells without lifting the chest off.
1230.err: Using the legs and hips to bounce the weight up.

1231.m: Rhomboids, Lats, Rear delt, Biceps, Traps
1231.cue: Loop the band around your feet or a door anchor, sit or stand tall, and pull the handles to your ribs, squeezing the shoulder blades.
1231.err: Rounding the back and shrugging the shoulders up.

1232.m: Lats, Rhomboids, Obliques, Spinal erectors, Biceps
1232.cue: Stand wide over two kettlebells in a hinge, brace with one hand on a bell and row the other, alternating sides without standing up.
1232.err: Twisting the torso open on each row.

1233.cue: Lie with knees bent, hands lightly by your head, and curl your shoulders off the floor by shortening the distance between ribs and pelvis.
1233.err: Pulling on the neck with the hands.

1234.cue: Lying on your back, bring one elbow toward the opposite knee while extending the other leg, alternating slowly with control.
1234.err: Rushing and flapping the elbows without rotating the ribcage.

1235.cue: With knees bent at 90°, curl your hips off the floor toward your chest, then lower slowly without swinging.
1235.err: Just swinging the legs without lifting the pelvis.

1236.cue: Hook your feet on a decline bench and curl your upper back up toward your thighs, keeping the lower back on the pad.
1236.err: Dropping fast on the way down.

1237.cue: Feet anchored, curl up one vertebra at a time until your chest reaches your thighs, then roll back down slowly.
1237.err: Yanking up with the arms and a straight back, using only the hip flexors.

1238.cue: Lock your feet on a decline bench, cross arms on chest (or hold a plate), and sit all the way up, lowering slowly.
1238.err: Bouncing off the bench at the bottom.

1239.cue: Adjust the seat, hold the handles or pads, and crunch forward by rounding the spine, not by pushing with the arms.
1239.err: Pushing the weight with the arms or hips instead of the abs.

1240.cue: Lying on your side with knees bent (or on your back with knees dropped to one side), crunch your top shoulder toward your hip.
1240.err: Pulling the head with the hand instead of using the side of the waist.

1241.cue: Hold one dumbbell at your side, bend sideways toward it, then use the opposite side of your waist to stand back up straight.
1241.err: Holding dumbbells in both hands, which cancels the work out.

1242.m: Abs, Hip flexors, Obliques, Forearm flexors
1242.cue: Hang from the bar, brace, and pull your knees up toward your chest while tilting the pelvis up; lower without swinging.
1242.err: Swinging the body to get the knees up.

1243.cue: Back against the pad and forearms on the rests, lift your knees (or straight legs) up, curling the hips off the pad at the top.
1243.err: Kicking the legs up fast and dropping them, using only the hip flexors.

1244.m: Abs, Hip flexors, Lats, Obliques, Forearm flexors
1244.cue: Hang from the bar and raise straight legs until your toes touch the bar, pushing down on the bar with straight arms to help.
1244.err: Bending the knees a lot and swinging uncontrolled.

1245.cue: Lie flat with hands under your hips, keep the lower back pressed down, and raise straight legs to vertical, lowering slowly.
1245.err: Lower back arching off the floor as the legs come down.

1246.cue: Lie on your back, lift both straight legs a few centimetres off the floor and kick them up and down in small, quick movements, lower back flat.
1246.err: Lower back arching up off the floor.

1247.m: Abs, Obliques, Lats, Hip flexors, Glutes
1247.cue: Lie on a bench gripping it behind your head, lift your body onto your upper back, and lower it as one straight, rigid line without bending at the hips.
1247.err: Piking at the hips and letting the lower back arch.

1248.m: Abs, Hip flexors, Triceps, Quads, Front delt, Serratus
1248.cue: Press down through locked arms to lift your body, and hold straight legs out in front at hip height with toes pointed.
1248.err: Shoulders shrugged up to the ears and knees bending.

1249.cue: From lying flat with arms overhead, lift your legs and torso at the same time to touch your toes, then lower with control.
1249.err: Crashing back down to the floor between reps.

1250.m: Abs, Hip flexors, Front delt, Quads, Obliques
1250.cue: From a high plank, drive one knee toward your chest, then switch legs quickly while keeping hips level and hands under shoulders.
1250.err: Hips bouncing high in the air.

1251.cue: Sit leaning back with a tall chest, feet down or raised, and rotate your ribcage side to side, moving the weight beside each hip.
1251.err: Only moving the arms while the torso stays still, and rounding the back.

1252.cue: Hold the end of the bar with straight arms overhead and swing it in an arc to each hip by rotating through hips and trunk, controlling every rep.
1252.err: Bending the arms and arching the lower back.

1253.cue: Set the cable low, hold the handle with both hands by one hip, and rotate up and across to above the opposite shoulder, pivoting the back foot.
1253.err: Pulling with the arms instead of rotating the trunk and hips.

1254.m: Abs, Front delt, Serratus, Chest, Quads
1254.cue: Hold the top of a push-up with hands under shoulders, body straight from head to heels, glutes and abs tight.

1255.m: Abs, Obliques, Front delt, Serratus, Glute med
1255.cue: From a high plank with feet wide, tap one hand to the opposite shoulder without letting the hips rock side to side.
1255.err: Rushing so the hips swing with every tap.

1256.cue: On forearms with feet on sliders, slowly push your body back past your elbows and pull it forward again, keeping a rigid plank.
1256.err: Lower back sagging as you slide back.

1257.m: Obliques, Glute med, Abs, Side delt
1257.cue: In a side plank on your forearm, lower your hip toward the floor and lift it back up as high as possible, controlling each rep.
1257.err: Rolling the hips forward or backward instead of straight up and down.

1258.cue: Kneel with forearms on the ball and roll it forward, extending at the shoulders while keeping a straight line from knees to head, then pull back.
1258.err: Letting the hips drop and lower back arch.

1259.m: Abs, Obliques, Serratus, Front delt, Glutes
1259.cue: Plank with forearms on a stability ball and make small circles with your elbows, keeping the hips and spine perfectly still.
1259.err: Making huge circles so the hips shift around.

1260.m: Abs, Lats, Serratus, Front delt, Hip flexors
1260.cue: From standing, hinge to place the wheel on the floor and roll out until your body is nearly parallel to the floor, then pull back with the abs.
1260.err: Trying it before you can do full kneeling rollouts, and letting the back arch.

1261.cue: Exhale all your air, then draw your belly button in toward your spine as far as possible and hold without breathing in.
1261.err: Sucking in air instead of exhaling fully, or holding the breath with a red, strained face.

1262.cue: Lie with knees bent and shoulders slightly lifted, then reach side to side to touch each heel, keeping the shoulders off the floor.
1262.err: Dropping the head and shoulders to the floor between reaches.

1263.cue: Lie with arms out wide and legs raised to vertical (knees bent to make it easier), and lower them slowly to one side and then the other, shoulders flat.
1263.err: Letting the legs crash down and the opposite shoulder lift off.

1264.m: Obliques, Abs, Hip flexors, Lats, Forearm flexors
1264.cue: Hang and raise your legs to the bar (toes-to-bar position), then rotate them from side to side like a windshield wiper with control.
1264.err: Swinging the whole body instead of rotating at the hips.

1265.cue: Lie with your lower back on the ball, let your spine extend over it, then crunch up through the full range.
1265.err: Rolling the ball back and forth instead of curling the spine.

1266.cue: Hold the hollow position—lower back pressed down, arms and legs extended—and rock back and forth without losing the shape.
1266.err: Bending at the hips so it turns into a sit-up motion.

1267.cue: On hands and knees, lift your knees 2–5 cm off the floor with a flat back and hold, breathing steadily.
1267.err: Pushing the hips high up toward the ceiling.

1268.cue: Sit on the GHD with feet locked, lower back until your torso is parallel (or slightly past), then sit up by kicking the knees straight.
1268.err: Doing high volume too soon—very hard on the abs and can cause severe soreness or injury.

1269.cue: Sit leaning back on your hands or balanced on your hips, then pull your knees and chest together and extend the legs out again.
1269.err: Rounding forward with the shoulders while the legs barely move.

1270.cue: Stand side-on to a high cable, hold the handle by your ear, and crunch sideways, bringing your ribs toward your hip.
1270.err: Pulling with the arm and leaning the whole body instead of bending at the waist.

1271.cue: Adjust the pad to your head, sit tall, and move your neck slowly forward, back and to each side through a pain-free range with light weight.
1271.err: Jerking the head quickly or going heavy too soon.

1272.m: Lats, Triceps, Chest, Biceps, Front delt, Abs, Forearm flexors
1272.cue: Use a false grip, pull the rings to your ribs, then roll your chest over quickly and press out of the deep dip.
1272.err: Losing the false grip at the top of the pull, so the transition fails.

1273.m: Front delt, Triceps, Traps, Serratus, Abs, Forearm flexors
1273.cue: Hands shoulder-width a hand-length from the wall, arms locked, push the floor away and squeeze glutes and abs into a straight line.
1273.err: Arching the lower back into a 'banana' and sinking into the shoulders.

1274.m: Front delt, Triceps, Abs, Serratus, Traps, Chest
1274.cue: From a push-up with feet at the wall, walk your feet up and hands in until your chest nearly touches the wall, then walk back down slowly.
1274.err: Rushing down and letting the hips sag, which crunches the lower back.

1275.m: Front delt, Triceps, Traps, Forearm flexors, Abs, Serratus
1275.cue: Kick up with control, stack hips over shoulders over hands, and balance by pressing through your fingers.
1275.err: Kicking up too hard with no bail plan; always learn to cartwheel out first.

1276.m: Front delt, Chest, Triceps, Serratus, Abs, Biceps
1276.cue: Turn fingers out or back, place hands by your hips and lean your shoulders well past your hands, then do push-ups keeping the lean.
1276.err: Losing the forward lean as you push up, turning it into a normal push-up.

1277.m: Lats, Abs, Teres major, Rear delt, Rhomboids, Triceps
1277.cue: Hang with straight arms, pull the bar down toward your hips and raise your tucked body until your back is horizontal.
1277.err: Bending the elbows and rounding the back so the hips drop below shoulder level.

1278.m: Lats, Abs, Teres major, Rear delt, Rhomboids, Glutes, Triceps
1278.cue: From an advanced tuck, extend your legs wide apart with hips extended; keep arms straight and body horizontal.
1278.err: Piking at the hips so the legs sit higher than the torso.

1279.m: Lats, Abs, Teres major, Rear delt, Rhomboids, Glutes, Triceps, Spinal erectors
1279.cue: Hold your whole body straight and horizontal under the bar, legs together, arms locked, pressing the bar toward your hips.
1279.err: Training it daily to failure; the elbows and lats need recovery between sessions.

1280.m: Lats, Chest, Biceps, Front delt, Abs, Spinal erectors
1280.cue: From a skin-the-cat position, lower your tucked body until it faces the floor horizontally behind the rings, arms straight.
1280.err: Rushing into deep shoulder extension without biceps and shoulder prep; build up slowly.

1281.m: Lats, Chest, Biceps, Front delt, Abs, Glutes, Spinal erectors
1281.cue: Hold a straight, face-down horizontal body behind the hands with arms locked and glutes squeezed.
1281.err: Bending the elbows, which shifts all the stress onto the biceps tendon.
1281.hard: Back lever pull-out to inverted hang

1282.m: Front delt, Chest, Serratus, Biceps, Abs, Forearm flexors
1282.cue: In a push-up position with fingers pointing back or out, lean your shoulders forward past your hands and protract your shoulder blades.
1282.err: Bending the elbows and letting the chest sink between the shoulder blades.

1283.m: Front delt, Serratus, Chest, Triceps, Biceps, Abs, Forearm flexors
1283.cue: Lean forward on straight arms, lift your feet and hold knees tucked to chest with a rounded upper back and hips at shoulder height.
1283.err: Bent arms; it becomes a crow pose and won't build planche strength.

1284.m: Obliques, Lats, Side delt, Front delt, Triceps, Abs, Glute med
1284.cue: Grip the pole wider than shoulders, top arm pulling and bottom arm pushing hard, and hold your body sideways and horizontal.
1284.err: Bending the bottom arm, which overloads the shoulder and drops the hips.

1285.m: Rhomboids, Lats, Biceps, Rear delt, Traps, Abs
1285.cue: Lean back with a straight body, pull the rings to your lower ribs while turning palms in, then lower with control.
1285.err: Sagging hips and shrugging the shoulders toward the ears.
1285.easy: Ring row with feet closer (more upright)

1286.m: Triceps, Chest, Front delt, Serratus, Abs, Lats
1286.cue: Press up to straight arms on the rings, keep them close to your sides with palms turned forward and shoulders pushed down.
1286.err: Shrugging up and letting the rings shake wide.

1287.m: Quads, Chest, Glutes, Triceps, Front delt, Abs, Calves
1287.cue: Squat, kick your feet back to a plank, do a push-up, jump your feet back in and jump up with arms overhead.
1287.err: Letting the hips sag in the plank and landing stiff-legged.

1288.m: Abs, Front delt, Quads, Serratus, Triceps, Obliques, Hip flexors
1288.cue: On hands and toes with knees hovering an inch off the floor, crawl forward moving opposite hand and foot, back flat.
1288.err: Hips shooting up high and the back rounding.

1289.m: Triceps, Glutes, Rear delt, Hamstrings, Abs, Front delt
1289.cue: Sit, place hands behind you with fingers back, lift hips level and walk forward or back with opposite hand and foot.
1289.err: Letting the hips drop toward the floor.

1290.m: Glutes, Quads, Hamstrings, Calves, Spinal erectors, Front delt
1290.cue: Swing your arms back while hinging, then drive arms forward and jump as far as you can, landing softly in a quarter squat.
1290.err: Landing on the heels with straight legs and falling backward.

1291.m: Quads, Glutes, Hamstrings, Calves, Soleus, Abs
1291.cue: Dip and swing your arms, jump onto the box landing softly with both feet flat in a squat, then stand and step down.
1291.err: Choosing a box so high you land in a deep squat; jumping back down repeatedly stresses the Achilles.

1292.m: Quads, Hip flexors, Glutes, Calves, Abs, Soleus
1292.cue: Jump straight up and drive your knees to your chest at the top, then land softly and rebound quickly.
1292.err: Bending forward to meet the knees instead of lifting them.

1293.m: Quads, Glutes, Calves, Soleus, Hamstrings, Abs
1293.cue: Step (don't jump) off a 30–60 cm box, land on both feet and immediately jump as high as possible with minimal ground contact.
1293.err: Using a box that's too high so you sink deep and stall; do only low volume when fresh.

1294.m: Glute med, Quads, Glutes, Adductors, Calves, Obliques
1294.cue: Leap sideways from one leg to the other, landing softly on the outside foot with knee over toes and the trailing leg behind.
1294.err: Landing with the knee collapsing inward.

1295.m: Quads, Glutes, Hamstrings, Calves, Adductors, Abs
1295.cue: From a lunge, jump up and switch legs in the air, landing softly back in a lunge with the front knee over the foot.
1295.err: Back knee slamming into the floor on landing.

1296.m: Calves, Side delt, Glute med, Adductors, Soleus, Quads
1296.cue: Jump your feet wide while raising your arms overhead, then jump back together, staying light on the balls of your feet.

1297.m: Triceps, Chest, Front delt, Abs, Serratus
1297.cue: Support on top of a bar, lean forward slightly and lower until the bar touches your upper abs, then press to lockout.
1297.err: Legs swinging forward and staying upright, so you fall back off the bar.

1298.m: Quads, Calves, Glutes, Hamstrings, Soleus, Breathing muscles
1298.cue: Walk at a brisk pace you could still talk at, stand tall and let your arms swing naturally without holding the rails.
1298.err: Gripping the handrails, which cuts the work and ruins posture.

1299.m: Glutes, Calves, Hamstrings, Quads, Soleus, Spinal erectors, Breathing muscles
1299.cue: Set the incline to 6–12% at a moderate pace, lean slightly from the ankles and keep your hands off the rails.
1299.err: Hanging on the console at max incline, which removes most of the benefit.

1300.m: Quads, Calves, Glutes, Hamstrings, Soleus, Hip flexors, Breathing muscles
1300.cue: Run at a steady conversational pace with short quick steps landing under your hips; 1% incline mimics outdoor running.
1300.err: Overstriding and heel-slamming far in front of the body.

1301.m: Quads, Hamstrings, Glutes, Calves, Hip flexors, Breathing muscles
1301.cue: After a full warm-up, sprint hard, then straddle the belt or drop to a walk to recover; keep the safety clip attached.
1301.err: Jumping on and off a fast-moving belt without the safety key.

1302.m: Glutes, Quads, Hamstrings, Calves, Soleus, Breathing muscles
1302.cue: Step through the whole foot at a pace you can sustain, stand tall and only touch the rails lightly for balance.
1302.err: Leaning forward on the rails and taking tiny steps on the toes.

1303.m: Quads, Glutes, Hamstrings, Chest, Lats, Calves, Breathing muscles
1303.cue: Keep feet flat on the pedals, push and pull the handles, and use resistance so you're not just spinning with momentum.
1303.err: Zero resistance and leaning heavily on the handles.

1304.m: Quads, Glutes, Hamstrings, Calves, Breathing muscles
1304.cue: Set the seat so your knee is slightly bent at the bottom of the stroke, and pedal smoothly at 80–100 rpm.
1304.err: Seat too low, which overloads the front of the knee.

1305.cue: Sit back against the seat with knees slightly bent at full reach, and pedal at a steady, comfortable effort.
1305.err: Sitting so close that your knees come up toward your chest.

1306.m: Quads, Front delt, Glutes, Hamstrings, Chest, Lats, Triceps, Breathing muscles
1306.cue: Push and pull the handles while pedaling; the harder you go the more resistance the fan gives.
1306.err: Starting an interval all-out and dying after 10 seconds; pace the effort.

1307.m: Quads, Lats, Glutes, Hamstrings, Rhomboids, Biceps, Spinal erectors, Breathing muscles
1307.cue: Sequence legs, then hips, then arms on the drive; reverse it on the return: arms, hips, then knees.
1307.err: Pulling with the arms first and rounding the back.
1307.easy: Rowing technique drill at low rate

1308.m: Lats, Triceps, Abs, Glutes, Hamstrings, Rear delt, Breathing muscles
1308.cue: Reach tall, then pull the handles down by hinging at the hips and bending the knees slightly, finishing with hands past the hips.
1308.err: Doing all the work with the arms and squatting too deep.

1309.m: Calves, Soleus, Quads, Side delt, Forearm flexors, Breathing muscles
1309.cue: Turn the rope with your wrists, elbows close to your sides, and make small low hops on the balls of your feet.
1309.err: Jumping too high and swinging the rope with the whole arm.

1310.m: Calves, Soleus, Quads, Abs, Forearm flexors, Side delt, Breathing muscles
1310.cue: Jump slightly higher with straight body and flick the wrists fast so the rope passes twice under your feet per jump.
1310.err: Bending the knees and kicking the heels back (donkey kick).

1311.m: Front delt, Abs, Biceps, Triceps, Forearm flexors, Quads, Glutes, Breathing muscles
1311.cue: In a half squat with a braced core, whip the ropes up and down fast with alternating or double arms.
1311.err: Standing straight-legged and making slow, small waves.

1312.m: Quads, Glutes, Calves, Hamstrings, Front delt, Triceps, Abs, Breathing muscles
1312.cue: Grip the poles with arms locked, lean forward at about 45°, and drive the floor back with short powerful steps.
1312.err: Rounding the back and pushing with the arms instead of the legs.

1313.m: Quads, Calves, Glutes, Forearm flexors, Traps, Breathing muscles
1313.cue: Hold the straps with straight arms, sit into a quarter squat and walk backward pushing through the balls of your feet.
1313.err: Leaning back and pulling with the arms.

1314.m: Quads, Glutes, Abs, Front delt, Calves, Breathing muscles
1314.cue: Warm up, then do 8 rounds of 20 s all-out effort and 10 s rest on one simple exercise (bike, burpees, squats).
1314.err: Choosing a technical lift that falls apart under fatigue.

1315.m: Lats, Front delt, Triceps, Chest, Abs, Glutes, Quads, Breathing muscles
1315.cue: Swim freestyle or breaststroke at an even pace, exhaling into the water and rolling to breathe; rest at the wall as needed.
1315.err: Holding the breath and lifting the head high, which sinks the hips.

1316.m: Quads, Calves, Glutes, Hamstrings, Soleus, Shin muscle, Breathing muscles
1316.cue: Walk fast enough to breathe harder but still talk, swing your arms and roll from heel to toe; aim for 7,000–10,000 steps a day.
1316.err: Walking in the midday summer heat; go early morning or evening and drink water.

1317.m: Hip flexors, Quads, Calves, Abs, Glutes, Breathing muscles
1317.cue: Run in place driving knees to hip height, staying on the balls of your feet and pumping your arms.
1317.err: Leaning back and landing heavily on the heels.

1318.cue: Kneel on one knee, tuck your pelvis under and squeeze the back glute, then shift forward until you feel the front of the hip stretch.
1318.err: Arching the lower back instead of tucking the pelvis.

1319.m: Glutes, Glute med, Hip flexors, Adductors
1319.cue: Sit with both knees bent at 90° (front leg rotated out, back leg rotated in), sit tall and lean gently over the front shin.
1319.err: Rounding the back and collapsing to one side.

1320.cue: Bring one shin forward across your body with the back leg straight behind, keep hips square and fold forward slowly.
1320.err: Forcing it with knee pain; use a box or the figure-four version if the knee complains.

1321.cue: Lie on your back, cross one ankle over the other knee, and pull the bottom thigh toward your chest.
1321.err: Lifting the head and shoulders and straining the neck.

1322.cue: Lie on your back, loop a strap around one foot and raise the straight leg until you feel a stretch, keeping the other leg flat.
1322.err: Bouncing and pulling into sharp pain.
1322.easy: Seated hamstring stretch with bent knee

1323.cue: Place your back knee against the wall with the shin up it, front foot forward, then squeeze the glute and raise your torso upright.
1323.err: Arching the low back to get upright instead of squeezing the glute.

1324.cue: Lie on your side with knees bent at 90°, then open the top arm across to the other side, following your hand with your eyes.
1324.err: Letting the knees lift and roll, so the low back twists instead of the upper back.

1325.cue: On all fours, reach one arm up to the ceiling, then thread it under your body and rest the shoulder down, then reverse.
1325.err: Sitting the hips back to the side instead of keeping them over the knees.
1325.hard: Thread the needle with 5 s hold at end range

1326.cue: On all fours, slowly round your spine up while tucking your chin, then arch it down while looking forward, moving with your breath.
1326.err: Moving only at the neck or low back instead of the whole spine.
1326.hard: Segmental cat-cow (one vertebra at a time)

1327.m: Hip flexors, Hamstrings, Glutes, Obliques, Adductors, Chest
1327.cue: Lunge forward, place the inside hand down, drop that elbow toward the instep, rotate and reach the arm to the ceiling, then straighten the front leg.
1327.err: Rushing through it without pausing in each position.
1327.hard: World's greatest stretch with hamstring rock-back

1328.cue: Place your forearm on the door frame with elbow at shoulder height, then step through gently until you feel the chest stretch.
1328.err: Placing the elbow too high and feeling a pinch in the front of the shoulder.
1328.easy: Wall pec stretch with straight arm low

1329.m: Rotator cuff, Rear delt, Teres major
1329.cue: Lie on your side with the bottom arm at 90° in front, then gently press the forearm toward the floor with the other hand.
1329.err: Pushing hard into pain; this should be a gentle stretch at the back of the shoulder.

1330.cue: Bring one straight arm across your chest and pull it closer with the other hand above the elbow, shoulder down.
1330.err: Shrugging the shoulder up toward the ear.

1331.m: Lats, Spinal erectors, Glutes, Rear delt, Breathing muscles
1331.cue: Kneel, sit your hips back toward your heels and walk your hands forward, breathing slowly into your back.
1331.err: Holding the breath and tensing the shoulders.
1331.easy: Child's pose with pillow under chest
