1332.cue: Stand in a split stance facing a wall and drive the front knee forward over the toes to touch the wall, heel staying down.
1332.err: Letting the heel lift or the arch collapse inward.

1333.cue: Hands on the wall, step one leg back with the heel down and knee straight, and lean forward until you feel the calf stretch.
1333.err: Turning the back foot out instead of pointing it straight.

1334.cue: Lie face down with the roller under your thighs and roll slowly from hip to just above the knee, pausing on tight spots.
1334.err: Rolling directly over the kneecap or rolling too fast.
1334.hard: Single leg with other leg stacked on top

1335.ar: Foam rolling – outer thigh (IT band area)
1335.cue: Lie on your side with the roller under the outer thigh, support with your top leg and hands, and roll slowly between hip and knee.
1335.err: Putting full bodyweight on it and gritting through pain; the IT band itself doesn't 'stretch'.
1335.easy: Roll the glute med with a ball

1336.cue: With the roller under your upper back, hands behind your head and hips up, roll from mid-back to shoulder blades and extend over it.
1336.err: Rolling down onto the lower back, which isn't protected by ribs.

1337.cue: Sit with the roller under your calves, lift your hips and roll from ankle to below the knee, turning the foot in and out.
1337.hard: Single calf with other leg stacked

1338.m: Front delt, Rear delt, Chest, Rhomboids, Rotator cuff, Traps
1338.cue: Hold a band with a wide grip and straight arms, then slowly circle it from in front of your hips over your head to behind your back and return.
1338.err: Using a grip too narrow so you bend the elbows or arch the back to get through.

1339.m: Adductors, Glutes, Soleus, Quads, Spinal erectors, Hip flexors
1339.cue: Sit into the bottom of a squat with heels down and chest up, using your elbows to gently push your knees out.
1339.err: Heels lifting off the floor; hold a doorframe or put a small plate under the heels at first.
1339.easy: Assisted deep squat holding a post
1339.hard: Goblet squat hold with light weight

1340.cue: Sit tall, tilt your ear toward one shoulder and gently pull with the same-side hand while the other shoulder stays down.
1340.err: Yanking the head; neck stretches should be gentle.

1341.cue: Sit or stand tall and glide your chin straight back to make a 'double chin', hold 3–5 s, then relax.
1341.err: Tilting the head down instead of gliding it straight back.
1341.easy: Chin tuck lying on your back

1342.cue: On all fours, rock gently over your hands with fingers forward, sideways and backward, then do palm-up rocks and wrist circles.
1342.err: Skipping it before handstands or push-up work and loading cold wrists.

1343.cue: Sit with soles of the feet together, hold your ankles, sit tall and gently let your knees fall toward the floor.
1343.err: Bouncing the knees or pushing them down hard with the elbows.

1344.cue: Lie face down, place hands under your shoulders and gently press your chest up, keeping hips on the floor and shoulders down.
1344.err: Forcing full lockout with pain in the lower back.

1345.cue: Kneel facing a bench, place elbows on it with hands together, then sit your hips back and drop your chest.
1345.err: Arching the lower back instead of feeling it in the armpits and sides.
1345.hard: Lat stretch holding a pillar (one arm)

1346.cue: On all fours, slide your knees wide with shins parallel and ankles in line with knees, then rock hips back gently.
1346.err: Going too wide too fast and straining the groin.

1347.m: Glutes, Quads, Traps, Hamstrings, Spinal erectors, Front delt, Calves, Forearm flexors
1347.cue: Lift off with a flat back, extend explosively at hips, knees and ankles, then pull under and catch on the front of your shoulders in a quarter squat.
1347.err: Reverse-curling the bar with the arms instead of extending the hips; learn with a coach and an empty bar first.

1348.m: Glutes, Traps, Hamstrings, Quads, Spinal erectors, Front delt, Forearm flexors
1348.cue: Start standing, slide the bar to just above the knees by hinging, then jump explosively and catch it in a quarter squat on your shoulders.
1348.err: Hitting the bar off the thighs and swinging it out away from the body.

1349.m: Quads, Glutes, Traps, Hamstrings, Spinal erectors, Front delt, Abs, Forearm flexors
1349.cue: Pull from the floor as in a power clean, then drop under into a full front squat with high elbows and stand up.
1349.err: Elbows dropping in the catch so the bar rolls forward off the shoulders.

1350.m: Quads, Glutes, Front delt, Traps, Hamstrings, Triceps, Spinal erectors, Abs
1350.cue: Clean the bar to your shoulders and stand, re-set your breath, then dip, drive and split under to lock it overhead.
1350.err: Pressing the bar out instead of driving with the legs and getting under it.
1350.hard: Competition clean and jerk at heavy singles

1351.m: Glutes, Quads, Traps, Hamstrings, Front delt, Side delt, Spinal erectors, Abs, Triceps
1351.cue: Wide grip, lift with a flat back, extend explosively and pull under the bar to catch it locked overhead in a full overhead squat.
1351.err: Catching with soft, bent elbows; learn it with a PVC pipe and a coach before adding weight.

1352.m: Glutes, Traps, Quads, Hamstrings, Front delt, Side delt, Spinal erectors, Triceps
1352.cue: Pull as in the snatch but catch the bar overhead with locked arms in a partial (above-parallel) squat.
1352.err: Pressing out the bar after catching with bent arms.

1353.m: Glutes, Traps, Hamstrings, Quads, Front delt, Side delt, Spinal erectors, Abs
1353.cue: From standing, hinge the bar to mid-thigh or knee, then extend explosively and pull under to catch overhead in a squat.
1353.err: Starting the pull early with the arms before the hips finish extending.

1354.m: Front delt, Quads, Triceps, Glutes, Traps, Abs
1354.cue: Dip straight down, drive the bar up with your legs, then push yourself under into a quarter squat with arms locked, and stand.
1354.err: Dipping with the chest falling forward so the bar drives out in front.

1355.m: Front delt, Quads, Triceps, Glutes, Traps, Abs, Hip flexors
1355.cue: Dip and drive, then split your feet front and back as you punch under the bar; recover front foot first, then back.
1355.err: Front knee caving or back leg locked straight with heel down.

1356.m: Traps, Glutes, Hamstrings, Side delt, Spinal erectors, Quads, Biceps
1356.cue: Pull as in a clean, extend fully onto the toes, then let the elbows travel high and out, bringing the bar to lower-chest height.
1356.err: Bending the arms early, turning it into an upright row.

1357.m: Traps, Glutes, Hamstrings, Side delt, Rear delt, Spinal erectors, Biceps
1357.cue: With a snatch grip, extend explosively and pull the bar close to the body up to chest height with elbows high and out.
1357.err: Letting the bar swing away from the body.

1358.m: Glutes, Hamstrings, Traps, Quads, Spinal erectors, Forearm flexors
1358.cue: Lift as in a clean, keeping the bar close, then finish with a violent hip extension and shrug onto the toes, arms straight.
1358.err: Rushing the first pull so the hips shoot up before the bar leaves the floor.

1359.m: Glutes, Front delt, Hamstrings, Quads, Traps, Triceps, Abs
1359.cue: Hinge with the dumbbell between your feet, extend explosively and pull it close to the body, then punch it overhead to lockout in one motion.
1359.err: Rounding the back at the bottom and pressing the weight up slowly at the end.

1360.m: Glutes, Hamstrings, Forearm flexors, Biceps, Abs, Traps
1360.cue: Hike the bell back, snap your hips and guide it close to the body into the rack position, letting it land softly on the forearm.
1360.err: Swinging it out wide so it flips over and bangs the wrist.

1361.m: Quads, Glutes, Spinal erectors, Abs, Traps, Obliques, Calves
1361.cue: Set the bar on your upper back like a squat, brace hard, stand it up and walk with short, fast steps keeping the yoke level.
1361.err: Taking long strides that make the yoke swing side to side.

1362.m: Spinal erectors, Abs, Biceps, Traps, Rhomboids, Quads, Glutes
1362.cue: Hug the bag high against your chest, lean back slightly with a braced core, and walk with quick short steps.
1362.err: Letting the bag slide down so the back rounds.

1363.m: Glutes, Hamstrings, Spinal erectors, Biceps, Traps, Quads, Abs
1363.cue: Straddle the bag, lap it onto your thighs, then extend your hips explosively and toss it over one shoulder; alternate sides.
1363.err: Trying to curl it up with the arms instead of driving the hips.

1364.m: Glutes, Hamstrings, Spinal erectors, Biceps, Lats, Traps, Quads, Forearm flexors
1364.cue: Wrap the stone, lap it, re-grip high, then drive your hips through and extend to roll it onto the platform.
1364.err: Lifting with straight legs and a fully rounded back from the floor without lapping it first.

1365.m: Front delt, Triceps, Chest, Traps, Abs, Quads, Glutes
1365.cue: Clean the log to your chest with high elbows, take a breath and brace, dip and drive it overhead, pushing your head through.
1365.err: Leaning back excessively and pressing with an overarched lower back.
1365.hard: Log clean and press for reps

1366.m: Glutes, Hamstrings, Quads, Spinal erectors, Biceps, Chest, Triceps, Calves
1366.cue: Set up chest to the tire with fingers under the tread, drive forward and up with your legs, then knee or push it over.
1366.err: Deadlifting it straight up with a rounded back and bent arms (biceps tears are a real risk).

1367.m: Abs, Spinal erectors, Biceps, Quads, Glutes, Traps, Obliques
1367.cue: Cradle the bar in the crooks of your elbows close to your body, brace hard, stand tall and walk with short steps.
1367.err: Letting the bar drift away from the body so the upper back rounds; use a pad or sleeve for the elbows.

1368.m: Glutes, Quads, Hamstrings, Calves, Spinal erectors, Abs
1368.cue: Wear the harness or hold the rope, lean forward and drive powerfully through each step, pushing the ground behind you.
1368.err: Standing upright and letting the arms do the pulling.

1369.m: Lats, Biceps, Rhomboids, Forearm flexors, Spinal erectors, Abs, Glutes
1369.cue: Stand in an athletic half squat and pull the rope hand over hand to bring the sled toward you, keeping your back flat.
1369.err: Rounding the back and pulling with straight legs.
1369.easy: Seated rope pull with light sled

1370.m: Glutes, Hamstrings, Forearm flexors, Spinal erectors, Quads, Traps, Lats
1370.cue: Grip the thick bar double-overhand or mixed, pull the slack out with lats tight, then push the floor away and lock out.
1370.err: Starting with a loose grip that opens up halfway; train grip separately.

1371.m: Abs, Spinal erectors, Biceps, Traps, Quads, Glutes, Forearm flexors
1371.cue: Bear-hug the keg high on your chest or carry it on one shoulder, brace, and walk fast with short steps.
1371.err: Leaning so far back that the low back takes all the load.
